_about: One generated keyframe per cinematic shot (Resources/Cinematics/Art/<file>.jpg, 1280x720). make_reels.py wires them into the reels (back = file, cast = who is in it). Shots with cast are painted with Hawkes Gen image.paint on the character sheets below as references (at most two), so each character stays on-model; shots without cast are image.generate. The full prompt is scene + place + style (+ the cast clause). Look source: Assets/Resources/UI/MenuArt.png (the sheets were made from it with image.edit).
style: Stylized 3D animated-film render, deep blue shadows with warm gold accents, soft lantern light and low mist, cinematic 16:9 composition. No sparks, glitter, embers or fireflies. No watermark, no captions.
castClause: Keep every character exactly as on their reference sheet: the same design, colours and proportions. Each character appears once.

wallit.name: Wallit
wallit.look: Wallit, a brown leather bifold wallet with a cartoon face (heavy black eyebrows), green banknotes sticking out of the top, thin brown arms and legs, white cartoon gloves, white sneakers, a plain wooden baseball bat

slice.name: Slice
slice.look: Slice, a pale goth woman with short black hair and dark lipstick in a long glossy black gown with long sleeves and a small silver pendant, a slim silver scalpel knife in her hand

yobot.name: Yo Bot
yobot.look: a Yo Bot, a small chirpy glossy black robot with a hinged lid, a wide cyan glowing screen face with happy pixel eyes, pincer claws and stubby legs

spiderbot.name: Spider Bot
spiderbot.look: a Spider Bot, a glossy black domed robot on six long jointed legs with a glowing cyan-green screen face

courier.name: The Courier
courier.look: the Courier, an Alpha Yo Bot with coral-red glowing screen face and seams, a small red postal cap and a clipboard with a pinned notice

foreman.name: The Foreman
foreman.look: the Foreman, a huge Mega Yo Bot with thick amber-yellow armour plates, an amber glowing screen face and a paper work order clipped to its chest

server.name: The Server
server.look: the Server, a Spider Bot with a lilac-violet glowing screen face and seams, holding out a folded white paper on one front leg

orderbearer.name: The Order-Bearer
orderbearer.look: the Order-Bearer, a tall heavy Spider Bot with a deep red glowing screen face and a long paper order sealed with red wax strapped across its back

places.hollow: the Moonlit Hollow at night: a grassy hollow ringed by trees and old iron lanterns, nine standing stones around a pale gold circle of light on the grass
places.edge: the edge of the Moonlit Hollow at night: the last lantern, a chalk road running into blue dark, far off a thin blank gate
places.floor: the Clearing Floor at night: a sunken yard lit amber by hanging lamps, rows of hooks holding identical small robot chassis, a long conveyor belt, one red signal lamp
places.walk: the Long Walk at dusk: a pale stone slab causeway over a pit of mist, paired tall lamp stilts like folded spider legs
places.reading: the Reading Room: a bare round hall lit lamp-gold, a circle drawn on the floor, the walls lined with rows of identical paper forms
places.filed: the Moonlit Hollow at blue dawn: the Department's wall reduced to a row of broken stumps, a pale slab path leading to a white doorframe on a dais, the circle glowing on the grass
places.dawn: the filed circle at dawn: the Moonlit Hollow under a warm gold-blue sky, the circle glowing gold on the grass
